description: This PHP class defines the Text utility within the Goteo project, providing methods for retrieving, translating, processing, and rendering localized text messages, including formatting, HTML sanitization, and external resource linking.

classes.name: Text
classes.description: A utility class for managing localized text, including retrieval, translation, sanitization, and rendering functionalities tailored for the Goteo project.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a translated text string by its ID, with compatibility for variable arguments.

methods.name: sys
methods.description: Gets system language translation of a text ID.

methods.name: lang
methods.description: Core method for fetching a localized string, applying Symfony translation or sprintf formatting as needed.

methods.name: html
methods.description: Returns the text as HTML, escaping if necessary.

methods.name: plain
methods.description: Returns the text without HTML tags.

methods.name: slash
methods.description: Returns the text with escaped quotes for Javascript usage.

methods.name: isHtml
methods.description: Checks if a text ID is marked as HTML content.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Fetches all text records matching filters and language, including group translations.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves or updates a text translation record.

methods.name: setPending
methods.description: Marks a translation as pending.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a text translation record.

methods.name: groups
methods.description: Returns available text groups with translated labels.

methods.name: wcount
methods.description: Counts the number of words in a given string, excluding HTML tags.

methods.name: wordCount
methods.description: Calculates the total words in specified fields of a database table for sections like texts, pages, or contents.

methods.name: widget
methods.description: Generates embed code for project widgets with support for multiple types and styles.

methods.name: shareLinks
methods.description: Creates social media share URLs for Twitter and Facebook.

methods.name: GmapsLink
methods.description: Creates a Google Maps link for a location.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Removes accents and special characters from a string for normalization.

methods.name: urliza
methods.description: Converts a text into a URL-friendly slug.

methods.name: recorta
methods.description: Recorta (truncates) a text string to a specific length, preserving HTML integrity.

methods.name: ultima_palabra
methods.description: Gets the last word in a string based on separators.

methods.name: cerrar_etiquetas
methods.description: Auto-closes unclosed HTML tags in a string.

methods.name: urlink
methods.description: Converts URLs in plain text into clickable HTML links.

methods.name: cutUrlParams
methods.description: Removes query parameters and protocol identifiers from a URL.

methods.name: tags_filter
methods.description: Removes potentially dangerous script, iframe, form, and embed tags from HTML content.

methods.name: getErrors
methods.description: Returns the list of errors encountered in translation or processing.
